scope: Exposed descriptive Figure1B-D adapter with fixed D1/D2/D2b methods; no animal-level inference or scientific acceptance
historical_runtime: runtime/ is preserved historical provenance; its Git-less image must not execute this job

container.nonroot_user: existing source owner UID/GID; never root
container.output: one fresh allocated parent mounted at analysis/research/runs; runner creates unique p001_figure1_v1_<attempt> directory

before_dispatch: exact committed frozen contract and source hashes
one authoritative coordinator ledger with unique attempt and immutable packet
verified private checkpoint and source/packet recovery material
reviewed-job receipt bound to actual contract hash
completed metadata after-run checkpoint and root memory acceptance
qualified two-part synthetic Drive upload/readback/reassembly with exact external hashes
frozen Figure1 contract, immutable packet and new verified before-dispatch checkpoint; no prior metadata reservation reused
after_run: verify unchanged Ravel receipt and every declared output
verify container exit/OOM state, PID zero and captured process identities absent
hash and privately export full outputs/logs plus packet/source bindings; verify downloaded bytes
memory_review: Record full descriptive stage cumulative process peak and sampled cgroup peak separately; no inference from metadata alone.
failure: Preserve failed attempt/outputs/logs and checkpoint terminal or uncertain state. No automatic retry, parameter rescue, new RQ, claim promotion, merge or subsequent analysis.
inputs: Reuse the nine retained files from the completed metadata attempt; rehash before execution. No download, regeneration or metadata rerun.
resource_basis: Sparse loader observed ~924 MiB cumulative peak. Figure QC retains only filtered cells before concatenation; only retained 2000-HVG embedding is densified. 16 GiB/4CPU/3600s is a bounded first full-workload budget, not predicted need or a guarantee. Hold rather than rescue on OOM/deadline/method failure.

host_preflight.concurrency: one scientific attempt; no overlapping qualification containers

artifacts.format: Preserve exact outputs and Ravel receipt/logs; ZIP DEFLATE outside offline scientific container; no H5AD rewriting. Private runtime routing stays outside public Git.
artifacts.verification: Record external archive+manifest hashes; upload each part/manifest once to existing owner-only folder, retrieve exact bytes, verify per-part and reconstructed whole SHA, then ZIP CRC and every manifest entry. Unknown or denied uploads hold; no bypass or blind retries.
artifacts.publication: Public-source result files and summaries only after content review; private checkpoints/task/process/source staging locators never published.
